entries.title: On a phone, a project map opens full screen and stays live
entries.body: A tap on a project map in a card, or on its Full screen button, opens the map over the whole screen. There you drag to move it, pinch to zoom, tap a box to choose it and tap it again to go inside. Done brings you back to the card, which shows the map where you left it. In the card, a finger on the map scrolls the card.
